_comment: Every source the Workshop imports. tools/fetch_sources.py downloads the 'git' sources into data/raw/<id> at the pinned commit, and the 'http' sources at the pinned SHA-256. 'local' sources are committed in this folder. Status values: verified (checked by tools/verify_sources.py), local (committed here), planned (not fetched yet).

sources.title: Plato, Greek text (Burnet's Oxford Classical Text, 1900-1907), Perseus TEI/EpiDoc edition
sources.citation_scheme: CTS urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0059.tlgNNN; Stephanus page+letter in <milestone unit='section' resp='Stephanus'>
sources.provenance: Scanned by Perseus (St. Olaf, 1992) from Burnet, Platonis Opera, Oxford 1900-1907; EpiDoc/CTS conversion 2017; the TEI header of each file names the volume and an Internet Archive scan.

sources.title: Plato, English translations in the Loeb and other editions, Perseus TEI (Fowler, Lamb, Bury, Shorey and others)
sources.citation_scheme: Same Stephanus milestones as the Greek
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Perseus encoding); the 1914-1935 Loeb translations are public domain in the US
sources.provenance: Translator per dialogue is read from each file's TEI header (<editor role='translator'>) and listed in reports/verification.md.

sources.title: GLAUx corpus, Plato files: lemma, morphology and syntax for every word
sources.citation_scheme: Each word carries div_page and div_stephanus_section (e.g. 29e) from the Perseus text
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the Plato files (per metadata.txt)
sources.provenance: Keersmaekers, The GLAUx corpus (2021). The Perseus Plato text annotated by trained statistical taggers (lemmas about 98.8% accurate, morphology about 97.2%). Euthyphro, Apology, Crito and Clitophon include hand-checked treebank sentences; the Timaeus is entirely machine-tagged (analysis='auto'). Shown in the Workshop as tagged data, never as established fact.

sources.title: Perseus Morpheus analyses: every possible parse of every Greek form (Beta Code)
sources.citation_scheme: Keyed by inflected form in Beta Code
sources.licence: Perseus data; the CLTK repository gives no separate licence. Personal use.
sources.provenance: The Perseus Hopper 'greek-analyses' table generated by the Morpheus rule-based analyser (no statistics). Used to show every grammatical possibility next to GLAUx's single tagged choice.

sources.title: Liddell, Scott and Jones, A Greek-English Lexicon (9th edition, 1940), Perseus TEI
sources.provenance: Perseus Digital Library digitisation of LSJ.

sources.title: Liddell and Scott, An Intermediate Greek-English Lexicon (1889), Perseus TEI
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 US, with the request to offer Perseus any modifications
sources.provenance: Perseus text 1999.04.0058, downloaded 2015 by B. Linskey, with small typo fixes.

sources.title: Liddell, Scott and Jones, A Greek-English Lexicon (9th edition, 1940): front matter, with List I (Authors and Works) and List V (General List of Abbreviations), Perseus text 1999.04.0057
sources.citation_scheme: <div1 n='1'> List I, <div1 n='5'> List V, one <item> per abbreviation
sources.licence: CC BY-SA (Perseus Digital Library availability statement in the LSJ files); LSJ 1940 front matter
sources.provenance: Perseus Digital Library's TEI of LSJ, downloaded from its dltext service, which serves the whole lexicon; only the opening <front> (preface, lists of abbreviations) is kept, about 0.4 MB. The GitHub copy of LSJ (source 'lsj') leaves the front matter out. Used to expand LSJ's abbreviations with LSJ's own wording; never paraphrased.

sources.title: Herbert Weir Smyth, A Greek Grammar for Colleges (American Book Company, 1920), Perseus text 1999.04.0007
sources.licence: The 1920 book is public domain; Perseus encoding, Perseus Digital Library terms (credit Perseus, offer corrections)
sources.provenance: Perseus Digital Library TEI P4 of Smyth's grammar, downloaded whole from its dltext service. The word box quotes the sections listed in sources/grammar/smyth-sections.json, as Smyth wrote them.

sources.title: Guidelines for the annotation of Ancient Greek in the Ancient Greek Dependency Treebank 2.0 (Celano and others), Perseus treebank_data
sources.citation_scheme: Section 3 of the guidelines, one heading per syntactic label (PRED, SBJ, OBJ, ATR ...)
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 US (per the repository README)
sources.provenance: The annotation guidelines GLAUx says it follows for its sentence roles. The word box shows each label's definition as the guidelines give it, without the links to example trees.

sources.title: Jowett, Timaeus: translation with Introduction and Analysis (3rd ed., 1892), Project Gutenberg #1572
sources.citation_scheme: None printed; aligned to Stephanus by hand later (milestone 6)
sources.licence: Public domain (Project Gutenberg licence on the file)
sources.provenance: GITenberg mirror of Project Gutenberg ebook #1572, produced by Sue Asscher. gutenberg.org itself is blocked from this environment.

sources.title: The Works of Plato, translated by Floyer Sydenham and Thomas Taylor, 5 vols (London, 1804), OCR text
sources.citation_scheme: Volume and page of the 1804 edition; no Stephanus numbers printed
sources.provenance: Uploaded by Daniel on 2026-11-05 as Plato_Works_Sydenham_Taylor.zip: Internet Archive 'djvu.txt' OCR of the AMS Press (New York, 1972) facsimile of the 1804 edition. Unproofread. Uses the long s, which the OCR reads as 'f'. See sources/taylor-1804/README.md.

sources.title: Proclus, In Platonis Rem Publicam commentarii (Kroll, 1899-1901), Greek, First1KGreek TEI
sources.citation_scheme: Kroll volume and page; needs a concordance to Stephanus
sources.provenance: Open Greek and Latin, First Thousand Years of Greek.
